name: relation_paged_160k_v12
status: completed native MP-SPDZ execution with exact reconstruction
scope_warning: One synthetic query, three Semi parties on one localhost, preprocessing included. This does not instantiate physical server separation, measure WAN latency, exercise a public KG ontology, or make the linear lookup sublinear.
protocol: MP-SPDZ Semi, mod prime, semi-honest dishonest majority, exactly three parties

layout.kind: dense relation-paged v12 with folded hop-two relation
layout.explanation: The synthetic fixture supplies no external public ontology. No edge-derived type map was introduced. The lossless global frontier of one was verified over the plaintext union for this benchmark; deployment needs the documented one-time MPC bound check.

execution.compiler_scale_note: Compilation processed more than 9.8 million reported lines and produced 413 bytecode files. It completed after the interactive wait was interrupted; schedule timestamps indicate roughly twelve minutes of compilation.

comparison_with_packed_scan_same_fixture.comparison_caveat: The v12 layout uses a verified global frontier of one, while the packed scan carries its configured six-slot owner-major frontier. The narrower v12 frontier is lossless on this fixture and is the primary source of the improvement.

verdict: The v12 relation-paged backend is executable and exact at 160,000 edges and 100,000 entities. It materially improves over the packed scan on this favorable bounded-degree fixture, but 44.7 GB per query and roughly twelve-minute compilation remain impractical.
